related.title: 同調接收 EVM：誤差能量與 SNR
related.titleEn: Coherent receiver EVM: error energy and SNR
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學率目標200 Gbit/s只由16QAM達成；需另外提出所需SNR與非線性驗證，不能直接批准升階。 constellation_labels.csv與速率/SNR分離判讀表 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 128 與變更 256 Gbit/s、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Only16QAM reaches the200 Gbit/s teaching target; require separate SNR and nonlinearity checks before approving modulation change. constellation_labels.csv and separate rate/SNR assessment Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 128 and changed 256 Gbit/s, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學等效SNR至少18 dB且誤差模型成立才通過；0.20組失敗，非AWGN誤差不回報成量測SNR。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Require18 dB equivalent SNR and a valid error model;0.20 fails, and non-AWGN residuals must not be reported as measured SNR.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成32 GBd；比較M=4和M=16，兩偏振同速且不計框架開銷。 名義式 2*32*log2(4) = 128 Gbit/s；變更式 2*32*log2(16) = 256 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列4與16點星座的位元標籤數；以每偏振每秒符號數獨立乘回，不把星座點數直接當位元數。
合成正規化EVM由0.10變0.20；參考星座平均能量固定為1。 名義式 10*log10(1/0.1**2) = 20 dB；變更式 10*log10(1/0.2**2) = 13.9794 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 從每點複數誤差平方平均算EVM，再用總信號能量/總誤差能量重算；保留旋轉與增益校正方式。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic32 GBd; compareM=4 andM=16 with equal polarization rates and no framing overhead. Nominal 2*32*log2(4) = 128 Gbit/s; changed 2*32*log2(16) = 256 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate label lengths for4- and16-point constellations; multiply symbols per polarization independently, not constellation count itself.

Synthetic normalized EVM changes from0.10 to0.20 with unit mean reference-symbol energy. Nominal 10*log10(1/0.1**2) = 20 dB; changed 10*log10(1/0.2**2) = 13.9794 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Compute EVM from per-symbol squared complex errors and cross-check total signal/error energy; retain phase/gain normalization rules.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NG-PON2：TWDM 波長負載平衡
related.titleEn: NG-PON2: load balancing across TWDM wavelengths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學率目標200 Gbit/s只由16QAM達成；需另外提出所需SNR與非線性驗證，不能直接批准升階。 constellation_labels.csv與速率/SNR分離判讀表 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 128 與變更 256 Gbit/s、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。

Only16QAM reaches the200 Gbit/s teaching target; require separate SNR and nonlinearity checks before approving modulation change. constellation_labels.csv and separate rate/SNR assessment Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 128 and changed 256 Gbit/s, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學峰值使用率不超0.8；搬移前失敗、後通過；搬移中斷需單獨列入驗收。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching peak utilization limit0.8: before fails and after passes; migration interruption requires separate acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成32 GBd；比較M=4和M=16，兩偏振同速且不計框架開銷。 名義式 2*32*log2(4) = 128 Gbit/s；變更式 2*32*log2(16) = 256 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列4與16點星座的位元標籤數；以每偏振每秒符號數獨立乘回，不把星座點數直接當位元數。

合成4波長各10 Gbit/s，負載[9,3,3,3]；將第一波長3 Gbit/s移到第二，成[6,6,3,3]。 名義式 max(9,3)/10 = 0.9 peak utilization；變更式 max(6,3)/10 = 0.6 peak utilization。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐波長求和前後皆18 Gbit/s；畫熱點而非只報45%平均使用率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic32 GBd; compareM=4 andM=16 with equal polarization rates and no framing overhead. Nominal 2*32*log2(4) = 128 Gbit/s; changed 2*32*log2(16) = 256 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate label lengths for4- and16-point constellations; multiply symbols per polarization independently, not constellation count itself.

Synthetic four10 Gbit/s wavelengths carry[9,3,3,3]; move3 Gbit/s from first to second, yielding[6,6,3,3]. Nominal max(9,3)/10 = 0.9 peak utilization; changed max(6,3)/10 = 0.6 peak utilization. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Per-wavelength sums remain18 Gbit/s; plot the hotspot rather than reporting only45% mean utilization.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
